svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Open-bottomed box 1000 long, 500 deep, 450 high, 20 mm walls:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1.5 mm galvanised sheet riveted to a 20 x 20 x 3 angle frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front (aisle) face: opening 800 x 400, 100 in from each end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 above the bottom edge. Fold the opening edges back 15 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hopper end: 120 mm hole for the barrel, centre 250 from the front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face and 150 above the bottom edge (10 mm clear of the barrel).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: cut-out for a 250 mm duct spigot, centre 575 from the hopper

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end and 350 from the front face; rivet the spigot on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom flange: 20 x 20 angle, six 9 mm holes for M8 bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the extruder frame top (900 mm up), bolted down;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the hopper stays outside, against the hopper end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the barrel turns clear of the hole all round.
